English: A starter rod with line hook and float. Bring worm bait and fish from the bank. Pump the rod and give line during strong runs.
Schinese: 配有鱼线、鱼钩和浮漂的入门鱼竿。携带虫饵在岸边使用。交替抬竿和送竿收线；鱼猛冲时适当放线，避免硬拉断线。

English: Worm bait prepared from rotten flesh. Each accepted cast uses one bait. Not edible.
Schinese: 从腐肉中挑选并整理的鲤鱼虫饵。每次有效抛投消耗一份，不能食用。

English: A whole carp. Cook one fish on a campfire grill to make one meal. Cannot be eaten raw.
Schinese: 完整的鲤鱼。使用篝火和烤架，将一条鱼烹饪为一份烤鲤鱼。不能直接生吃。

English: Freshly grilled carp. A simple meal after a successful fishing trip.
Schinese: 新鲜烤制的鲤鱼。一顿犒劳垂钓收获的简单餐食。
